text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Malta Labour Party celebrates its return to government after nine-and-half years in opposition. Party leader and Prime Minister Alfred Sant addresses mass meeting saying his government would be one for all Maltese. He insists Malta's withdrawal from NATO Partnership for Peace Programme should not be seen as signal that Malta wants to distance itself from Europe.

- The government has withdrawn its support for holding a forum by Swiss-based Crans Montana organisation in Malta. The forum would have brought together leaders from Europe and the Mediterranean to discuss political and economic issues. PLO leader and Bosnian president attended last year's forum in Malta.
- Sant insists that his government will implement what it promised in the electoral campaign.
